rejected_boundaries: Optional bezel and cabochon members cannot supply mandatory metal, smooth dome, setting function or a worn owner. A generic jewelry part does not establish a primary photographic subject or scene-prop function. Garment/body construction and frame composition do not represent intrinsic jewelry part structure.

uncertainties.detail: The positive parent owns generic ring-or-pendant part geometry, but the current catalog has no general object-form/component-structure role. wearable_accessory requires visibly worn ownership; neither parent parts nor its co_realized_with_same_subject_and_garment relation actually states wearing or attachment to a person. The two optional members and their human applicability do not make wearing, metal rim or smooth cabochon surface mandatory. Preserve exact parent/member/binding mapping for root taxonomy/native qualification.
